# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

Chic Builder takes security seriously across our web studio, serverless packages, and cloud deployments. If you discover a vulnerability or security risk, please report it privately:

- ✉️ **Email**: [dakshrawat320@gmail.com](mailto:dakshrawat320@gmail.com)

Please include a detailed description of the vulnerability, affected components, and steps to reproduce. We will coordinate a swift fix before public disclosure.
